description: This Java source file defines the SubscriptionEventAdapter class, which maps SubscriptionEvent instances to and from Adaptable objects in the context of a protocol adapter framework. It handles specific event types related to subscriptions in a system, serializing and deserializing event data to protocol messages.

classes.name: SubscriptionEventAdapter
classes.description: Final class that maps between SubscriptionEvent instances and Adaptable objects within a protocol context, handling different subscription event types and their serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method that creates a new SubscriptionEventAdapter instance with specified header translator and error registry.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns a string representing the type of the adaptable, combining a prefix with a search action.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a SubscriptionEvent into an Adaptable with appropriate topic path, payload, and headers based on the event type.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the set of TopicPath.Criterion that this adapter is interested in, specifically SEARCH.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an empty set, indicating no specific actions are associated with this adapter.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates whether this adapter is used for responses; returns false.

methods.name: getSearchActions
methods.description: Returns the set of SearchAction values that this adapter handles, including COMPLETE, NEXT, FAILED, GENERATED.
